chunks: And whatever is in it from Al-Hasan ibn ʿAli ibn Abi Hamzah, I have narrated it from Muhammad ibn ʿAli Majilawayh—may Allah be pleased with him—from his uncle Muhammad ibn Abi al-Qasim, from Muhammad ibn ʿAli al-Ṣayrafi, from Ismaʿil ibn Mihran, from Al-Hasan ibn ʿAli ibn Abi Hamzah al-Baṭaʾini.
ai.seo_question: What is the transmission chain to Al-Hasan ibn ʿAli ibn Abi Hamzah in Man La Yahduruhu al-Faqih?
ai.summary: This passage is a transmission-chain clarification from Man La Yahduruhu al-Faqih, identifying the sanad through which the author narrates from Al-Hasan ibn ʿAli ibn Abi Hamzah al-Baṭaʾini. Its significance lies in documenting hadith provenance and preserving the scholarly method of attribution in Shia hadith literature.
